id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

data.description: Field for holding data returned by the data spec.

title.description: The title of the component to display

redirectUrl.description:
The URL to go to when clicking on one of the components of the diagram.
The ID of the system clicked will be appended to the end.
For example, if redirectUrl is `/reliability/system-detail`, when clicking
on system `SYS-1` the user will be redirected to `/reliability/system-detail/SYS-1`.

riskScoreThresholdHigh.description: Threshold above which the risk score is classified as high.

riskScoreThresholdMedium.description: Threshold above which the risk score is classified as medium.

riskScoreMultiplier.description: Multiplier to use for the risk score returned from {@link #dataSpec}.

riskScoreDecimalPoints.description: The number of decimals to include in the displayed risk score.

displayRiskScoreInsideCircle.description: Whether to display the risk score inside the risk score circle.

displayRiskScoreUnderTooltipHeader.description: Whether to display the risk score beneath the tooltip header.

pulsingDots.description:
Boolean to specify whether the dots should have a "pulsing" animation.
NOTE: This will also cause the dot tooltip to have a pulsing animation.

title:
Component to render a process flow diagram (PFD) with color-coded indicators and tooltips
showing the risk score of each component asset in the diagram, as well as the highest-risk
subcomponents assets for each component asset. Also includes links to redirect to the details page
of each of the components.
name: UiSdlProcessFlowDiagram
